# StreamDek Mobile v2.1.9

*Version code 67*

## What's New

**Android episode notifications**
StreamDek can now notify you when a followed series has an episode coming soon and when that
episode becomes available. Each episode keeps its own notification identity, alerts are not
repeated after the same check runs again, and tapping one opens the exact series, season and
episode rather than a generic Home screen.

**Automatically select your last profile**
Mobile now has the same startup choice as TV. Turn on **Remember Last Profile at Startup** to skip
the profile picker and return to the profile you used last; leave it off when people sharing the
device prefer to choose every time.

**Continue Watching follows the exact episode**
Resume state is now the title, season, episode and position — not a temporary stream address.
Continue Watching resolves a source suitable for this device, preserves the saved position when
the source changes, and applies the seek only after that exact media is ready.

**Series pages know where you are**
Opening a series now selects a partly watched episode at its saved position, or the next unwatched
released episode after the last one you completed. This works from synchronized history even when
the series is no longer present in the Home Continue Watching row.

## Improvements

**Watched state is reversible and synchronized**
Episode and season actions change between **Mark as Watched** and **Mark as Unwatched**. Updates
appear immediately, are sent to SyncDek and configured tracking services, and preserve the exact
series, season and episode identity across Mobile and TV. Marking a season no longer moves the
screen into the next season; you remain on the season you changed.

**Subtitle source preferences now filter the list**
Choose **All sources**, **Built-in** or **Add-ons**. The setting controls which sources are queried
and displayed instead of merely choosing the tab that opens first. Built-in OpenSubtitles results
remain in Built-in, add-on results remain in Add-ons, and All sources combines both with a clear
origin label on every result.

**Preferred subtitle languages are enforced**
With **Show Only Preferred Languages** enabled, only the primary and optional secondary language
are shown. Full names, two-letter codes, three-letter codes and regional variants are normalized
before filtering. If neither requested language has a result, the subtitle drawer explains that
instead of showing an empty panel.

**Language search remains visible above the keyboard**
Short filtered language lists now account for the on-screen keyboard, so one to four matching
results can still be seen and selected.

**Only available seasons are shown**
Empty and future season placeholders are hidden until they have episodes and their release date
has arrived.

## Fixed

* Fixed cross-device Continue Watching losing the season and episode recorded by the other device,
resolving the series as a whole, or applying an episode's saved position to different content.
* Fixed stale resume work carrying one episode's timestamp into the next. A new episode starts at
zero unless that exact episode already has legitimate progress.
* Fixed Next Episode failing to complete the episode being left when the viewer entered the
transition from the legitimate ending/outro region.
* Fixed season-wide watched updates appearing locally while only part of the season reached
SyncDek or another device. Season progress is now submitted as one batch and reconciled using
normalized episode identities.
* Fixed subtitle tracks that appeared selected but rendered no cues. Subtitle type and encoding
are detected from the downloaded file, compatible text is rewritten as UTF-8, failed or expired
copies fall through to another matching result, and attachment is independent of video loading.
* Fixed built-in subtitle results appearing under Add-ons, preferred-source settings only changing
the active tab, and non-preferred languages remaining visible after filtering was enabled.
* Fixed collection and Continue Watching lists collapsing different episodes of the same series
into one card.
